sam_docs: Heads-up: ran into an odd behavior in the ruby SDK during token rotation on streaming endpoints. The sampleapp crashes instead of continuing the stream.

mike_rb: thanks, can you paste minimal steps to reproduce?

sam_docs: steps: 1) start sampleapp streaming demo, 2) call /rotate-api-key from admin UI, 3) client raises EOFError and exits. Gist with tiny repro: https://gist.github.com/abcd1234

julia_sre: quick note  network layer difference: our http client drops the socket on 401, go client retries. Ruby code currently treats EOF as terminal.

mike_rb: current loop is basically: ```ruby
stream.each_chunk { |c| process(c) }
rescue EOFError
  raise
end
```

leo_support: customers reported this yesterday when using the quickstart in a workshop. Workaround was to restart the quickstart. Not great UX.

sam_docs: i've opened a tiny PR that attempts to reconnect on EOF/ECONNRESET and re-auth, with exponential backoff and a test that simulates mid-stream 401: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/2491

ci-bot: PR 2491  CI results: linux/x86_64: passed, linux/arm64: passed, macos: error (bundle install failing with mismatched bundler), windows: pending.

mike_rb: hmm macos bundler error again. Could be the devtools matrix using system ruby vs rbenv. I'll try to reproduce locally on my mac.

julia_sre: if it's bundler we should avoid bumping Gemfile.lock in the patch. Perhaps pin bundler in CI matrix instead.

leo_support: also can we add a short note in the quickstart README "Token rotation & long-lived streams"? People assume restart is required.

sam_docs: will add a docs blurb and a changelog entry. Once CI green i'll merge. Also adding an integration test that runs the sampleapp and performs rotation to verify reconnect behaviour.

mike_rb: when implementing reconnect, watch for partially emitted JSON chunks. We should buffer and only yield complete events to consumers.

sam_docs: good call i'll add a small buffer and unit tests for partial-chunk handling.

ci-bot: windows CI finished: passed. macos fixed by pinning bundler to 2.3 in CI, all green.
